6i85nvte704jr057tv2c19co8l.value: After Ersagun's polypitch: each string tried at pitches around its own as a template of its harmonics, and the templates made to compete for the spectrum by non-negative matrix factorization (Lee and Seung, 1999; as PLCA, Smaragdis, 2006), seeded by harmonic summation (Klapuri, 2006). Checking every string of a strum at once is TC Electronic's PolyTune's idea (2010).
